title: In What Languages are Generative Language Models the Most Formal? Analyzing Formality Distribution across Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Manual annotation by native speakers classifying generated texts into formal, informal, or incohesive categories, using neutral, formal, and informal prompts to measure default formality distributions and style preservation across five languages.

Evaluating the formality of generated text as a proxy for cultural bias, assessing how training on varied data sources biases a multilingual model toward culturally specific registers (e.g., Modern Standard Arabic vs. dialectal Arabic).
